sermon.title: The Pattern to the Power 03/15/2020
sermon.speaker: Pastor David G. Kincer
sermon.summary: Pastor David G. Kincer traces the pattern of Jesus’ life: baptism in water and the Holy Ghost, fasting, and defeating Satan with Scripture. As He taught, the word exposed demons and He cast them out with authority. A praying, fasting church has that power; he shares a confrontation in his own office.
sermon.transcript_source: This transcript comes from YouTube’s automatic English captions, which supply the timing and the words. Punctuation, capitalization and paragraphing were added from the speaker’s pauses and then corrected by hand, and obvious caption errors (names, Bible references) were fixed; his wording was not rewritten. “[unclear]” marks a word or name that was not clear.

chunks.text:

scriptures.text_nkjv: Then they were all amazed and spoke among themselves, saying, “What a word this is! For with authority and power He commands the unclean spirits, and they come out.” And the report about Him went out into every place in the surrounding region.

chunks.short_answer: A supernatural God working in their life; at almost 77 he still needs God’s power.
chunks.text: Young believers need they need a supernatural God working in their life and they need to see the power of God working in their life now I’m 77 years old almost and my time is coming into the sunset but you young ones you can fast you can pray you can get into the word and God will enable you to reach the unbeliever and mature the saints could that be an amen.
